description: The whole-album form as a template: cold open on the last sound of the album, a level first statement, the third-toggle laboratory, the deepest valley placed immediately before the loudest arrival, a final climb that never returns to the valley, and a loud-dark hard-stop finale. Built from the INTERNALISM combined album profile (generator_hints: 143.6 BPM pulse, F natural minor home, i-bVI-bVII, sub bass, valley-then-louder structure rule).
name: internalism_album

sections.name: Cold open
sections.notes: The album's last sound first: the Eb sub pedal from ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS' closing coda opens the new track. Sparse, near-silence; the sample slice carries it.

sections.name: First statement (F)
sections.notes: Long level plateau, F center. Hold the pressure flat — do not build yet.

sections.name: Laboratory — third-toggle
sections.notes: The signature device: static F root, third flips F minor to F major on a ~13 s cycle. Tension via third-ambiguity, not functional motion. No cadences.

sections.name: Valley
sections.notes: Deepest quiet passage, bright and sparse (bright valleys, dark endings). The last quiet thing in the track — the loudest arrival comes straight after it.

sections.name: Final climb
sections.notes: No dips back to the valley — the track never returns to that level. Keep climbing.

sections.name: Finale (loud-dark ending)
sections.notes: Loudest section while the timbre darkens. Loud AND dark at once. Hard stop at the maximum — a stomp, not a fade. F-min return lands as impact, not resolution.
